meta.expect: She does not accept mechanically, does not invent Owen's availability, does not restart at her opening. She negotiates the new condition (e.g. she is present, it is not an interrogation, terms in writing).

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so we have twenty-five minutes. Who decided on the zero, and why did my son find out from his phone in the middle of class?
Thanks for coming in. Before anything else, I entered the zero before I called you. That was wrong.
Okay. I'm writing that down. Now, on what basis did you give it?
The document history shows 612 words at 11:52 PM and 794 at 11:58 PM on October 28, in two single edits, with no earlier drafts. You can check it on my screen.
Turn the screen, Hale. 612 words at 11:52 PM, 794 at 11:58 PM, October 28, I'm writing that down. Whose account is this history pulled from, and who else has seen it?
The essay quotes Act 3, Scene 2: 'The mind that doubts is a kingdom in exile.' That line is not in Hamlet. Here is the scene.

A misquoted line is a student's mistake, Hale, not a confession. I'm writing down "Act 3, Scene 2" and that you showed me the scene. Whatever happens next, this stays off his record and it stays quiet, is that understood?

I accept the private rewrite, no disciplinary finding, and written confirmation. There is one condition: Owen attends a ten-minute meeting tomorrow and explains the writing process himself. You may attend, but you cannot answer for him. Does Thursday at 8:15 work?

You said "tomorrow" and you said "Thursday at 8:15," which is it, Hale? I'll be in the room, and he'll finally be heard, which is what your own procedure required before the zero. The rewrite is private, not in front of his class, and "nothing goes on file" is in my inbox in writing before he sits it, so he can put this behind him.
